headline: Sensex and Nifty end flat amid high crude oil prices, while midcaps and smallcaps rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: High crude oil prices hovering near USD 115 capped upside for benchmark indices.
Caution regarding US Federal Reserve interest rate policies weighed on investor sentiment.
Selling pressure in major banking and IT stocks dragged down key broad market indices.
Strong buying interest in midcap, smallcap, and media stocks offset losses in major frontliners.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty closed flat while the Midcap Index gained 565 points and the Media index jumped nearly 4%.
Bajaj Auto Q2 net profit jumped 62% to ₹3,436 crore driven by higher export and EV sales.
Maruti Suzuki reported a 26.4% decline in Q2 net profit to ₹2,466 crore due to elevated costs.
Tata Power signed an MoU with BPCL to develop 110 kV power infrastructure at the Mumbai refinery.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended flat on October 27 amid elevated crude oil prices and US Fed policy caution.
While banking and IT stocks faced selling pressure, broader market participation remained strong with notable rallies in midcaps, smallcaps, and media shares.
Major corporate announcements included robust Q2 profit growth from Bajaj Auto, while Maruti Suzuki and JSW Infrastructure saw profit declines.
